review: Inspected original and prepared image. Warm watchful olive-brown mature male, shoulder-length silver hair and short neat beard, visible human face. Forest/steel-gray light guard costume, silver staff and abstract leaf buckler distinguish from Merlin and Night Forger. Whole feet, natural staff hand and shield grip, no text/crest references. Teatro painterly coherence. Integration and actual miniature readability remain to be verified.
